Every active MLS® townhome listing in Sardis, BC is on this page. A short comparison of the local sub-areas follows.
Garrison Crossing
Garrison Crossing: once the CFB Chilliwack base and now a walkable village that mixes heritage-style homes, townhomes and condos.
Sardis South
Sardis South: townhome sites and newer subdivisions on the way to Cultus Lake Road and the Vedder River.
Vedder Crossing
Vedder Crossing: the south side's main commercial area, with condos and townhomes that sit close to the Vedder River.
Sardis East Vedder
Sardis East Vedder: long-established residential streets lying east of Vedder Road, with shops, parks and Sardis Secondary close by.
Sardis West Vedder
Sardis West Vedder: west of Vedder Road, where you find quiet cul-de-sacs, gated adult complexes and the Vedder River trails within reach.
Promontory
Promontory: above Sardis on the hillside, with view homes and newer townhome complexes, mostly built 1995–2020.

Under the BC Strata Property Act, townhomes are held as strata title. Before you remove subjects, get Form B, the depreciation report, the rental, pet and age-restriction bylaws and the strata minutes for the past two years. In 55+ and 45+ complexes, at least one occupant has to meet the age bylaws.

Floodplain: the Fraser and Vedder River floodplain takes in parts of Yarrow, Rosedale, Greendale, Fairfield Island and lower Sardis, and the City's dike network protects it. Ask what the flood construction level is for the property, what lenders and insurers require, and whether title shows a registered geotechnical or floodplain covenant.

Schools and transit: Chilliwack's schools come under School District 33 (SD33), whose schools include G.W. Graham Middle-Secondary, Sardis Secondary and Chilliwack Secondary, along with many elementary catchments (Unsworth, Watson and Vedder among them). Confirm the catchment with SD33 before buying. BC Transit has routes on Luckakuck Way, Young Road and Vedder Road in Chilliwack, and Route 66 of the Fraser Valley Express runs between Chilliwack and both Abbotsford and Carvolth Exchange in Langley.

Where are townhomes for sale in Sardis usually located?

Townhomes in Sardis are found mainly in Promontory, Sardis West Vedder, Sardis East Vedder, Vedder Crossing, Sardis South and Garrison Crossing. Age, lot size and price vary between areas, so before you book showings I'd narrow things to two or three neighbourhoods.
How often do these Sardis townhome listings update?
Listings on this page update directly from the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® feed several times a day, so new listings, price changes and sold statuses appear quickly.
Which zoning, strata or ALR points matter before I buy a townhome in Sardis?

Townhomes are strata title under the BC Strata Property Act, so before subjects come off, ask for Form B along with the depreciation report, the bylaws covering rentals, pets and age limits, and the strata minutes from the past two years. Complexes restricted to 55+ or 45+ apply their age bylaws to at least one occupant.
Are any Sardis townhomes in the floodplain?

Parts of lower Sardis, Greendale, Rosedale, Yarrow and Fairfield Island are in the Fraser and Vedder River floodplain, where the City's dike network gives protection. Request the flood construction level for the property, learn what lenders and insurers require, and find out if a geotechnical or floodplain covenant is registered against the title.
Which schools serve Sardis townhomes?

The Chilliwack school district is School District 33 (SD33). South-side and Sardis addresses feed Sardis Secondary and G.W. Graham; the north side feeds Chilliwack Secondary. Catchments do change, so ask SD33 about the specific address.
Is public transit available near Sardis townhomes?

Yes. Chilliwack's local BC Transit routes run on Luckakuck Way, Vedder Road and Young Road. The Fraser Valley Express also connects to Abbotsford and Langley. In rural spots such as Columbia Valley, Greendale and Ryder Lake, there is little or no bus service.
